parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: An idempotent token used to ensure request idempotency.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous response.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword used for the search. Fuzzy search is supported.
